memory: Thank you, Michael, for your kind words about MonoBean and your trust in our brand. We're thrilled to hear about your passion for crafting quality beverages and creating a welcoming coffee environment. We're committed to ensuring your satisfaction with the new machine, and we're here to support you every step of the way. If you have any more questions or need further assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out. We're excited to help you take your coffee-making journey to the next level!
